identity.name: The Kyiv Independent
identity.description: An English-language Ukrainian news outlet founded by former Kyiv Post journalists, covering Ukraine's war, politics, business and society for an international audience.

ownership.ownershipNotes: No single owner; reader- and membership-funded with philanthropic support. Created in November 2021 by journalists fired from the Kyiv Post after ownership interference.

editorialOrientation.evidence: Founded specifically to preserve editorial independence after ownership interference at the Kyiv Post; funded by readers and grants rather than the state.
editorialOrientation.source: Ownership and self-description via Official about page; secondary references; feed-level sample

politicalLeaning.evidence: MBFC rates The Kyiv Independent Left-Center with High factual reporting; coverage is strongly pro-Ukrainian but professionally sourced.

economicPerspective.evidence: Economic coverage is secondary and framed through war, reconstruction and energy security.

internationalAlignment.evidence: Clear Ukrainian national and pro-Western alignment, with strong coverage of EU/NATO integration and the war with Russia.
internationalAlignment.source: Ownership, editorial positioning and regional coverage sample

reliability.evidence: MBFC rates factual reporting High and credibility High; independent newsroom with named reporters and corrections.

externalRatings.notes: MBFC: Left-Center; factual reporting High; credibility High (retrieved 2026-10-25).

intelligence.knownPerspective: Ukrainian wartime coverage in English, strongly pro-Ukrainian and pro-Western but with professional sourcing and an independent newsroom.

selectionRationale: Adds essential Ukrainian English-language reporting and a frontline perspective absent from Russian state media and Western wires.

research.researchNotes: Official About page confirms founding history and funding model. Feed validated via news-archive endpoint. Legal entity still needs confirmation. Research is feed-level only; full article sampling and peer review remain outstanding.
